sections.content:

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let's track what happens as target continues up
# Maybe target wraps around or stops at top
# Also check if new targets appear

result = action(['UP'] * 8)

seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = None
targets = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O': player = n
    elif n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3: targets.append(n)

red_squares = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R')

print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}")
if player:
    p_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in player['boundary']])
    p_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in player['boundary']])
    print(f"Player: pixels={player['pixels']}, cols {p_cols[0]}-{p_cols[-1]}, rows {p_rows[0]}-{p_rows[-1]}")

print(f"Green 3-pixel targets: {len(targets)}")
for t in targets:
    t_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in t['boundary']])
    t_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in t['boundary']])
    print(f"  Target: cols {t_cols[0]}-{t_cols[-1]}, rows {t_rows[0]}-{t_rows[-1]}")

print(f"Red squares: {red_squares}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check animation for clues
if hasattr(last_action_result, 'get') and last_action_result.get('executed_actions'):
    for i, ea in enumerate(last_action_result.get('executed_actions', [])):
        anim = ea.get('animation', {})
        if anim.get('total_cells_changed', 0) > 0:
            print(f"  Action {i} animation: {anim.get('total_cells_changed')} cells changed, {anim.get('num_frames')} frames")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
